host.cpu: AMD Ryzen 5 3550H with Radeon Vega Mobile Gfx

measurement_scope: request construction plus public finite_action_minimax call; process startup, serialization, independent oracle and figure rendering excluded
performance_claim: descriptive single-adapter observation; no speedup, comparison winner, scalability, or source-mapped limiter claim
measurement_order: alternating lambda 0 and lambda 1; one process per warmup/measurement pair
memory_observation: Linux getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss per measurement process; not a per-stage or per-call allocation trace
terminal_representation: Numerical bounded V representation; 256 vertices per objective
